operations.description: This API returns a list of Printouts.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] almaws task lists printouts [PATH] almaws task lists printouts [PARAMS] id letter limit offset printer printout status [SCHEMA] schema

operations.description: This Web service returns a Printout given a Printout ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] almaws task lists printouts printout id [PATH] almaws task lists printouts [PARAMS] id printout [SCHEMA] items

operations.description: This API returns a list of requested resources to be picked from the shelf in Alma
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] almaws task lists requested resources [PATH] almaws task lists requested resources [PARAMS] by circ desk direction inst library limit location offset order pickup printed reported [SCHEMA] schema

operations.description: This API returns a list of lending requests in Alma
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] almaws task lists rs lending requests [PATH] almaws task lists rs lending requests [PARAMS] format library partner printed reported requested status supplied [SCHEMA] cost schema shipping

operations.description: This API is used to test if the API key was configured correctly.It returns a short XML (no schema available - the output is subject to changes) with the following structure:<test>GET - OK - institutionCode: 01ABC_INST</test>
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] almaws task lists test [PATH] almaws task lists test [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This API performs an action on printouts: mark as printed or canceled. 10,000 records can be handled in one requests. Only printouts which were updated will be returned.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] almaws task lists printouts [PATH] almaws task lists printouts [PARAMS] id letter op printer printout status [SCHEMA] schema

operations.description: This API operates on an printout. given a Printout ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] almaws task lists printouts printout id [PATH] almaws task lists printouts [PARAMS] id op printout [SCHEMA] items

operations.description: This API performs an action on requested resources that are on the shelf in Alma
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] almaws task lists requested resources [PATH] almaws task lists requested resources [PARAMS] circ desk inst library location op pickup printed reported [SCHEMA] schema

operations.description: This API preforms the requested action on a list (specified by given filters) of lending requests in Alma
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] almaws task lists rs lending requests [PATH] almaws task lists rs lending requests [PARAMS] format library op partner printed reported requested status supplied [SCHEMA] cost items shipping
